summary: Frontend smoke/regression pass after Metro watcher stabilization fix (iteration 32). Tested on web preview (mobile viewport 390x844) via https://gmail-notify-service.preview.emergentagent.com. All 5 requested scenarios PASS. Zero 'undefined is not a function' errors, zero pageerrors, zero console errors. Login as mei@demo.com works, all 5 bottom tabs navigate cleanly, VIP glossy checkmark badges render on Fad/Goga/Demo User (Connect) and Goga (Chats), header titles render at 24px size (Chats/Connect/Moments/Profile), 1:1 chat with Diego Ramírez renders messages, composer sends 'Hello from smoke test' successfully and 'Delivered' receipt is shown beneath the latest sent message. Only minor non-blocking RN-web deprecation warnings observed (shadow* / pointerEvents) and one package version mismatch (@react-native-picker/picker 2.11.4 vs expo-expected 2.11.1).

react_native_issues.issue: Installed version 2.11.4 does not match expo-expected 2.11.1. Non-blocking but Expo warns on every startup. Reference: /var/log/supervisor/expo.err.log

Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking on web but should be migrated for future SDK compatibility.

action_items: Optional: align @react-native-picker/picker to 2.11.1 to silence Expo doctor warnings

rca_of_issue: Original crash: Metro's FallbackWatcher tried to fs.watch a non-existent path (@typescript-eslint/utils/node_modules/eslint/lib/cli-engine — ESLint 9 removed cli-engine). ENOENT killed the dev server and Expo Go received a broken bundle -> 'undefined is not a function' at React fiber passive-effects. Mitigation: pre-create the missing directory + clear Metro cache + restart supervisor expo. Verified stable via supervisorctl (expo RUNNING, uptime persistent) and full web smoke test with 0 console/page errors.
